physics-h3-q2.title: Partikel bermuatan kanthi massa
physics-h3-q2.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h3-q2.material: Partikel bermuatan kanthi massa m lan muatan q mlebu tegak lurus ing medan magnet seragam B lan nindakake gerak melingkar beraturan kanthi kacepetan v. Endi sing bener nuduhake jari-jari orbit r lan periode T partikel iki?
physics-h3-q2.s.s1.prompt: Partikel bermuatan kanthi massa m lan muatan q mlebu tegak lurus ing medan magnet seragam B lan nindakake gerak melingkar beraturan kanthi kacepetan v. Endi sing bener nuduhake jari-jari orbit r lan periode T partikel iki?

physics-h3-q2.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

physics-h3-c.title: [Mekanika 2 dimensi lanjutan]
physics-h3-c.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h3-c.material: [Mekanika 2 dimensi lanjutan] Jarak horizontal maksimum R proyektil sing ditembakake saka lemah kanthi kacepetan awal v₀ lan sudut θ marang horizontal yaiku R = (v₀² sin 2θ) / g. Yen ora ana hambatan hawa, pira sudut tembak θ supaya jarak horizontal paling dhuwur, lan pira sudut tembak liyane sing duwe jarak horizontal padha karo sudut tembak 30°?
physics-h3-c.s.s1.prompt: [Mekanika 2 dimensi lanjutan] Jarak horizontal maksimum R proyektil sing ditembakake saka lemah kanthi kacepetan awal v₀ lan sudut θ marang horizontal yaiku R = (v₀² sin 2θ) / g. physics-h3-c.s.s1.explain: Syarat supaya $\sin 2\theta$ maksimum yaiku $2\theta = 90^\circ \implies \theta = 45^\circ$. physics-killer-12.title: Ing bidang datar ana
physics-killer-12.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-12.material: Ing bidang datar ana rong rel konduktor sejajar kanthi jarak $\ell=0.5\,\mathrm{m}$, lan salah sijine ujung disambung nganggo resistor. Tahanan total sirkuit tertutup sing dumadi saka rel, batang konduktor, lan resistor yaiku $2\,\Omega$. Medan magnet seragam arah vertikal $B=0.5\,\mathrm{T}$ nutupi kabeh sirkuit, lan batang konduktor obah ing rel kanthi kacepetan tetep $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ arah ngedohi resistor. Sajrone batang pindhah $2\,\mathrm{m}$ ing $0.5\,\mathrm{s}$, fluks magnet sing nembus sirkuit owah sebesar $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x$. Pasangan endi sing bener kanthi urutan nuduhake kuat arus induksi sing mili ing sirkuit lan gedhene gaya njaba sing dibutuhake kanggo njaga batang kanthi kacepetan tetep? (Ora ana gesekan.)
physics-killer-12.s.s1.prompt: Ing bidang datar ana rong rel konduktor sejajar kanthi jarak $\ell=0.5\,\mathrm{m}$, lan salah sijine ujung disambung nganggo resistor. Tahanan total sirkuit tertutup sing dumadi saka rel, batang konduktor, lan resistor yaiku $2\,\Omega$. Medan magnet seragam arah vertikal $B=0.5\,\mathrm{T}$ nutupi kabeh sirkuit, lan batang konduktor obah ing rel kanthi kacepetan tetep $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ arah ngedohi resistor. Sajrone batang pindhah $2\,\mathrm{m}$ ing $0.5\,\mathrm{s}$, fluks magnet sing nembus sirkuit owah sebesar $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x$. Pasangan endi sing bener kanthi urutan nuduhake kuat arus induksi sing mili ing sirkuit lan gedhene gaya njaba sing dibutuhake kanggo njaga batang kanthi kacepetan tetep? (Ora ana gesekan.)
physics-killer-12.s.s1.explain: $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot2=0.5\,\mathrm{Wb}$, $|\mathcal E|=\dfrac{\Delta\Phi}{\Delta t}=\dfrac{0.5}{0.5}=1.0\,\mathrm{V}$ (cocog karo $=B\ell v=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot4$). $I=\dfrac{\mathcal E}{R}=\dfrac{1.0}{2}=0.5\,\mathrm{A}$. Gaya magnet sing ditampa batang $F=BI\ell=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot0.5=0.125\,\mathrm{N}$ (arah ngalangi gerak miturut hukum Lenz), lan amarga kacepetan tetep, gaya njaba uga $0.125\,\mathrm{N}$. Pengecekan: daya gaya njaba $Fv=0.125\cdot4=0.5\,\mathrm{W}=I^2R=0.25\cdot2$. Yen $\ell$ ketinggalan, $I=1.0\,\mathrm{A}$ (jawaban salah ①), yen $\ell$ ketinggalan ing gaya dadi $0.25\,\mathrm{N}$ (jawaban salah ②), lan kesalahan nglebokake $\frac12$ ing $\mathcal E$ dadi jawaban salah ④.

Medan magnet seragam arah vertikal $B=0.5\,\mathrm{T}$ nutupi kabeh sirkuit, lan batang konduktor obah ing rel kanthi kacepetan tetep $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ arah ngedohi resistor. Sajrone batang pindhah $2\,\mathrm{m}$ ing $0.5\,\mathrm{s}$, fluks magnet sing nembus sirkuit owah sebesar $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x$. Pasangan endi sing bener kanthi urutan nuduhake kuat arus induksi sing mili ing sirkuit lan gedhene gaya njaba sing dibutuhake kanggo njaga batang kanthi kacepetan tetep? (Ora ana gesekan.)
physics-killer-12.steps.0.explain: $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot2=0.5\,\mathrm{Wb}$, $|\mathcal E|=\dfrac{\Delta\Phi}{\Delta t}=\dfrac{0.5}{0.5}=1.0\,\mathrm{V}$ (cocog karo $=B\ell v=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot4$). $I=\dfrac{\mathcal E}{R}=\dfrac{1.0}{2}=0.5\,\mathrm{A}$. Gaya magnet sing ditampa batang $F=BI\ell=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot0.5=0.125\,\mathrm{N}$ (arah ngalangi gerak miturut hukum Lenz), lan amarga kacepetan tetep, gaya njaba uga $0.125\,\mathrm{N}$. Pengecekan: daya gaya njaba $Fv=0.125\cdot4=0.5\,\mathrm{W}=I^2R=0.25\cdot2$. Yen $\ell$ ketinggalan, $I=1.0\,\mathrm{A}$ (jawaban salah ①), yen $\ell$ ketinggalan ing gaya dadi $0.25\,\mathrm{N}$ (jawaban salah ②), lan kesalahan nglebokake $\frac12$ ing $\mathcal E$ dadi jawaban salah ④.
